title: A hybrid numerical method for a microscopic and macroscopic traffic flow model
summary: In this paper, we introduce a traffic flow model based on a microscopic follow-the-leader model, while enforcing maximal constraints on the density and velocity of the flow. The related macroscopic model can be represented in conservative formulation. By introducing an advected variable up with the flow, where p is the velocity offset, and u is the relative velocity, we reformulate the classical Aw-Rascle-Zhang (ARZ) model and the modified Aw-Rascle model to describe a realistic fundamental diagrams.
